description.value: When you use the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to cause tendrils of flame to stretch out from your fists and feet. Your reach with your Unarmed Strikes increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. A hit with such an attack deals fire damage instead of bludgeoning damage. If you spend 1 additional ki point when you use this feature, all Unarmed Strikes until the start of your next turn also deal an additional 1d6 fire damage.
